description: Fetch one case (conversation) by id: subject, requester, assignee, status, priority, type, SLA metrics, custom fields, last post preview. Use include (e.g. 'user,case_status,case_priority,team') to expand references and fields='+tags' for tags. Kayako: GET /api/v1/cases/{id}.json.

fields.description: Partial-output field rules, e.g. '+tags' to add tags to a case, or 'subject,status' to return only those.

include.description: Comma-separated resource types to expand instead of returning {id, resource_type} references, e.g. 'user,case_status,case_priority,team', or '*' for all.

name: kayako_get_case
title: Get a case
